The plugin is unchanged since 0.1.1; this release changes how it is built and published.

## What changed since 0.1.1

- **Built and attested by GitHub Actions.** The release's three files, `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css`, are now built from the tagged source by GitHub Actions and carry an artifact attestation of their build provenance. Check a downloaded file with `gh attestation verify main.js --repo Gameboard-dev/latex`.
- **Third-party licences.** `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt` in the repository lists the Rust crates compiled into the plugin, with their licence texts (generated by `licences/generate.py` with cargo-about).

## Requirements and installation

As in 0.1.1: Obsidian 1.8.7 or later, desktop only, and a TeX installation with LuaLaTeX and latexmk. See the [README](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/latex#requirements).
